Title: The Unbound Slugcat
Description:
"I was never supposed to be here."

[h1]Expect this mod to crash once Watcher releases![/h1]

Unbound, he / they
- Double jump by pressing jump again in the air. No other keybinds.
- Recharge is determined by ring colour
- Six pips to hibernate, one to save. This isn't meant to be an easy mod
- Entomophage (eater of bugs and meat)
- Terrible spear throw, but excellent maul
- Custom echo dialogue
- Unique overseer friend
- More, probably
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/a313e69a75d78e5961843d6149a5d33a/f3f3a328aeed96b6-69/s1280x1920/9b8a5cda1371e3f099ad612c904663896064ede9.png[/img]

[h1]Compatibilities[/h1]
[b]Dress My Slugcat[/b]- Has special slots for jumprings. Most graphics will be disabled if DMS is enabled.
[b]Random Buffs[/b]- If missing his tail, Unbound's cyan jumps are limited. However, NO graphics are enabled when Random Buffs is enabled (regardless of remix settings), as it completely breaks otherwise.
[b]Expedition[/b]- Sometimes starts in different locations than usual.
[b]Push to Meow[/b]- Has custom meows that sound similar to lizards.

[h1]Incompatibilities and Dependencies[/h1]
Using Simplified Moveset to wall-climb may cause Unbound to launch rapidly. It's funny, so I may keep it in or make it a future remix toggle.
No known incompatibilities. If you find one, please let me know- I wish to make this mod as compatible as possible!
People in modding servers insisted I add Regionkit and CRS as dependencies. They DO help, so they will stay dependencies.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
- Sometimes the game gets weird if you DON'T have More Slugcats enabled. I want to fix this, so please report any errors if you do not own the DLC!
- Sometimes this mod will ping your antivirus. This is because it finds files (used for atlases), checks if other mods are enabled (for compatibility, such as removing graphics so Random Buffs can work), and tracks keystrokes (used for Unbound's jump). If you are concerned, [url=https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/11f34ca9df115b530bc9f31d1039dfb49181afa8408fc332baf4d75d6400c5f8/behavior]here is the VirusTotal log[/url]. If you are STILL concerned, check the Github. You can read his code any time.
- SL_UnbKTBil has some awkward room tiles without proper collision that I missed. I know... :(

[h1]Latest Changelog[/h1]
- Fixed a minor bug causing Pebbles to skip a line of dialogue
- Fixed a bug causing Pebbles to be unable to try killing Unbound. You can get murdered again! Yay!
- Fixed a bug causing pupil colour to never be anything but red and removed all prior planned restrictions on it. You can now choose your own palette. (Previously, it was meant to simply be the effect colour with maximum saturation. But meh! Who needs that!)
- If the intro cutscene doesn't operate properly, meaning [spoiler]it doesn't kill Unbound[/spoiler], it will now re-attempt with mods such as HP Food Bar in mind.
- Added another beginning tutorial (note the tutorial CAN and WILL still kill you if you fail a jump, however)
- Fixed not having MSC causing the player to simply drown upon respawning after tutorial area
- Fixed a couple room settings that were odd or caused bugs
- Added even more debug logs
- Sped up Pebbles' cutscene
- Fixed Inspector not showing up in tutorial rooms in MSC
